summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Instagram-style mobile user profile redesign. All 13 core features tested and working correctly. The profile page closely replicates Instagram's UI/UX with gradient story highlights, 3-column post grid with 1px spacing, lazy loading, and post detail modal.

issues: Accessibility warning: DialogContent requires DialogTitle for screen readers (console warning, not blocking)

frontend: Profile header displays username with back button (<-) and menu (...)
Profile picture displays with gradient ring/border on own profile
Stats row (posts, followers, following) displays correctly with proper counts
Name, category (Men's/Women's Fashion), bio display correctly
Follow button visible for other users' profiles - toggles to 'Following' on click
Message (collaborate) button works - opens collaboration dialog with Subject and Message fields
Story highlights section displays with gradient ring borders (yellow-red-purple gradient)
Tab navigation (Grid, Reels, Tagged) switches active state with underline indicator
Post grid displays with 3 columns using grid-cols-3 class
Post grid has 1px spacing between images (gap-[1px] with bg-gray-100)
Clicking a post opens the post detail modal with image, caption, likes, comments
Post detail modal shows like button, comment button, share, bookmark, add comment input
Lazy loading implemented with IntersectionObserver (first 9 posts visible immediately)
Empty state shows 'No Posts Yet' message with Camera icon and 'Share your first post' link
Edit profile button opens bio editing dialog with textarea and character count (x/150)
Rewards button visible on own profile

critical_code_review_comments: PostDetailModal could benefit from DialogTitle for screen reader accessibility (console warning shows)
